handoff: Reproduced as a user: in a throwaway repo, the dev-build watch ran a 20 s check in a 20.5 s tick, and inbox said 'no heartbeat … run norn watch' while watch ran. Loop: harness test (evidence debug-gh77.test.ts), red 3/3, green on the 0 s control. Cause: act/check.ts awaits runShell inside the tick, holding the tick lock, so the next ticks are busy and markTick runs only after tick.end. Also: a running check shows as '(queued)'.
